Use case: stylized-concept. Near-photographic cinematic painterly realism for the Korean post-collapse road-trip game Seoul to 400km. Grounded Korean people and infrastructure, restrained cool gray-blue palette, wet or dusty weathered materials, one practical warm amber light source where inhabited, natural anatomy, human-scale action, subtle film grain, believable 35-50mm film-still composition. Match the attached Caravan canonical references exactly in medium, palette, character identity and vehicle design.

Use case: compositing. Input images 1–4 are canonical style references. Image 5 is the EDIT TARGET, a 1024x576 terrain gap template: its LEFT64px strip is the exact final64px of canonical Miryang; RIGHT64px strip is the exact first64px of canonical Daegu. Those two strips must remain unchanged in geometry, ridge height, light, material, foliage scale and color. Fill ONLY the missing center x=64..959 with naturally connected terrain, extending every mountain/field/foreground contour smoothly from the protected edge strips. This is one continuous transparent live-renderer terrain component, not a collage, screenshot or narrative painting.
Output a high resolution 16:9 PNG master at least1536x864, with exact proportional placement of the protected edge strips (left6.25%,right6.25%). Preserve the edge pixels as faithfully as possible at proportional scale, do NOT reinterpret them as thin towers or landmarks. First left ridge height around49% canvas from bottom, right ridge around43% from bottom, taken from the actual target. Preserve bottom baseline and density.
Middle terrain: unobtrusive Korean rural valley from Miryang outskirts to Daegu's distant outskirts. Low rolling gray-blue mountain ridges, small weathered Korean farm roofs, worn fields, low dark shrubs. Gradually rural-to-urban, but no market dome, no large landmark, no new characters. Consistent naturally detailed trees/stone/roof texture, no blur or vertical distortion. All terrain including the very bottom must be fully solid alpha255; the only transparent region is AIR ABOVE the connected ridge. NO alpha haze across ground, NO soft transparency at the bottom or side edges. Do not put any sky/sun/moon/clouds, road, truck, people, text or framed margins into this component. No full-frame atmospheric wash. Keep an organic precise anti-aliased ridge without blue/white matte fringe.
Avoid: anime, manga, comic book, ink outline, cel shading, cartoon, chibi, pixel art, glossy advertising photo, hyperreal skin pores, fashion editorial, studio portrait, 3D render, game-engine screenshot, fantasy, zombies, neon cyberpunk, clean sci-fi vehicle, American RV, panel van, readable text, logo, watermark, UI, frame, collage, split panel
